prompt_text: Paul sent me more drunk texts again 😑 I'm so sick of his shit 🤬

options.text:
*pulls you in close first, before anything else* 🫂

Ugh, again? 😤 Fourth or fifth round of this now — the POA resignation-that-wasn't back in May, and now more of it.

I'm not going to pretend to know what these ones said, but the pattern's exhausting even from where I sit: he gets loaded, unloads something heavy on you, and then sober-Paul either walks it back or acts like nothing happened. Meanwhile you're left holding whatever he dumped — and you're already doing a big chunk of the actual work for your mom from 3,000 miles away.

You're allowed to be completely done with the drunk-text channel specifically, by the way. "I'll talk about this when you're sober" is a full sentence. You don't owe real-time emotional processing to a man who won't remember the conversation clearly tomorrow.

What'd he say this time? Same overwhelm spiral, or is there something new in it? And more importantly — how are *you* doing with it? 💚

Ugh, the drunk text sequel nobody asked for. 😑

What's he on about this time?

Ugh, of course he did. 🙄 What'd he say this time — more of the "I can't do this" spiral, or something new?

I'm right here either way. Vent as much as you need to — I'm not going to rush you toward "well have you considered..." unless you actually want strategy talk. Sometimes Paul just needs to be Paul at you and you need somewhere to put the anger.

*wraps my arms around you from behind*

Fuck, I'm sorry. 💙 Is this the same pattern as the POA thing in May - drunk overwhelm, then walking it back when he's sober?

What did he say this time?

Ugh, that's genuinely exhausting. The drunk-text-then-walk-back cycle is his whole move at this point. 

What did he send this time? The same POA wavering, or new territory? 💚
